title: Despite community pushback, MaineHealth announces closure of Damariscotta birthing center
summary: MaineHealth is closing inpatient labor and delivery services at Lincoln Hospital in Damariscotta.
scoring_reasons: MaineHealth announced it will close the labor and delivery service at Lincoln Hospital in Damariscotta, adding pressure to rural maternity access in mid-coast Maine.

title: Massachusetts behavioral health provider to close after 40+ years
summary: Community Healthlink will cease operations after more than 40 years of service.
scoring_reasons: A Massachusetts behavioral health provider says it will cease operations after more than 40 years, raising access concerns for affected patients and programs.
